description: Versioned private image-pipeline structural boundary: legacy render v2, pose render v3 with optional reviewed shape v1, packaging input v2, retained RGBA source v1, and local reference/image stages v1. Actual byte hashes, palette/grid/alpha rules, graph/reference/catalog consistency, supported strategy and review/ownership require runtime admission. Source artifacts can contain private pixel bytes and are not public projections. Structural validation grants no provider execution, species fidelity or review authorization.
